selection.edition: international Loyverse API v1.0 personal access token (Composio tool coverage)
selection.ownership: Cavius International Limited (Loyverse), Limassol/Larnaca, Cyprus; global POS API at api.loyverse.com used in 170+ countries.

research.searchCoverage: Bounded 2026-09-13 review of official Loyverse API (https://api.loyverse.com/v1.0, Authorization Bearer personal access token, GET /merchant, GET /stores, GET /stores/{id}, GET /items, GET /items/{id}, limit 1-250 default 50, cursor pagination, errors array, 300 requests per 300 seconds), operator identity (Cavius International Limited, Cyprus), and dated incident search (Loyverse + security breach/incident). Status-page outages are availability, not a customer-data compromise. No qualifying current unresolved Loyverse API security incident was identified; this is not a breach-free claim.

research.edition: international Loyverse API v1.0 personal access token
research.searchCoverage: Official Loyverse API documents HTTPS host https://api.loyverse.com/v1.0, Authorization Bearer personal access token, GET merchant/stores/items, cursor pagination with limit max 250, and an errors array on failed requests. Operator is Cavius International Limited in Cyprus providing a global POS API. OAuth app tokens are a separate third-party edition and are omitted. Dated incident search on 2026-09-13 found availability incidents, not a current unresolved customer-data compromise.

incidents.finding: Public status aggregators recorded brief Loyverse service disruptions in 2026. Those are availability incidents, not a disclosed customer-data or API-credential compromise.
incidents.limitation: This is not a breach-free claim; live authentication remains unverified. Pinned source uses GET /merchant/ with a trailing slash.

research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.

adaptations: Credential-only healthcheck maps to GET /merchant/ with empty input, matching the pinned credential validator path including the trailing slash.
Native category is ecommerce: Loyverse is a POS/catalog API. Source Finance/Data are not in the Rust CATEGORIES allowlist.
HTTP 200 bodies with a populated errors array are demoted via http.errors.bodyErrorPaths [errors], matching pinned source.
OAuth authorization-code tokens are omitted; this recipe uses the documented personal access token.
The upstream user-agent is not sent.
